request: Fix registration issues in Studify app - user gets 'não foi possível realizar o cadastro' error. Deep analysis of auth components, SQLite relations, and user hooks.

db-init-fix.scope: Fix database initialization in authDb.js - handle SQLite openDatabaseAsync failures, add retry logic, prevent initialized flag from being set on migration failures

questions.text: How should we fix the database initialization race condition and error handling?

config.question: How should we fix the database initialization race condition and error handling?

options.label: Retry with exponential backoff
options.description: Retry SQLite openDatabaseAsync up to 3 times with increasing delays
cons: Doesn't fix root cause if DB is corrupted

options.label: Lazy init with promise reset on failure
options.description: Reset dbPromise to null on failure so next call retries
cons: Could retry indefinitely on permanent failures

options.label: Initialize once with schema validation
options.description: Run migrations in transaction, only set initialized=true after all succeed
cons: SQLite ALTER TABLE can't be in transaction

config.context: Current getDb() has race condition: if openDatabaseAsync fails, dbPromise stays rejected forever. Also initialized=true is set even if ALTER TABLE statements fail.

atomic-registration.scope: Make registerUser atomic using SQLite transactions to prevent check-then-act race condition

questions.text: How to make registration atomic and prevent duplicate email race condition?

config.question: How to make registration atomic and prevent duplicate email race condition?

options.label: INSERT OR IGNORE + check changes
options.description: Use INSERT OR IGNORE and check db.changes to detect duplicates
cons: Need to verify user was actually created

options.label: Transaction with SELECT FOR UPDATE
cons: SQLite doesn't support SELECT FOR UPDATE

options.label: Catch UNIQUE constraint error
options.description: Let INSERT fail on UNIQUE constraint, catch specific SQLite error code
cons: Need to parse SQLite error codes

config.context: Current code: SELECT to check email exists, then INSERT. Two concurrent requests can both pass SELECT and fail on INSERT with UNIQUE constraint error, which shows as generic 'não foi possível cadastrar'.

error-handling-improvement.scope: Improve error handling in RegisterScreen and authDb to surface real SQLite errors instead of generic message

questions.text: How to improve error handling to show meaningful messages to users?

config.question: How to improve error handling to show meaningful messages to users?

options.label: Parse SQLite error codes
options.description: Catch specific SQLite error codes (UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT, DISK_FULL, etc.) and map to user messages
cons: Need to know all SQLite error codes

options.label: Throw structured error objects
options.description: Create custom error classes (EmailExistsError, DatabaseError, etc.) with codes

options.label: Log full error, show user-friendly generic
options.description: Console.error the real error, show user a friendly message with error ID for support

config.context: Current catch block only checks for 'EMAIL_EXISTS' string. All other errors (constraint violation, disk full, corruption, timeout) show identical generic message.

password-hashing-upgrade.scope: Upgrade password hashing from SHA256 to proper KDF (bcrypt/scrypt/Argon2)

questions.text: Which password hashing algorithm should replace SHA256?

config.question: Which password hashing algorithm should replace SHA256?

options.label: bcrypt (via expo-bcrypt or similar)
options.description: Battle-tested, widely used, adjustable cost factor

options.label: Argon2 (via expo-argon2)
options.description: Winner of Password Hashing Competition, most secure
cons: May not work on Expo Go

config.context: Current implementation uses SHA256 with salt. SHA256 is fast - vulnerable to GPU brute force. Need proper KDF with work factor.

init-flag-fix.scope: Fix initialized flag logic - only set to true after ALL migrations succeed

questions.text: Should initialized flag only be set after all ALTER TABLE statements succeed?

config.question: Should initialized flag only be set after all ALTER TABLE statements succeed?
config.context: Currently initialized=true is set at the end of getDb() regardless of whether ALTER TABLE statements succeeded. If any migration fails, the flag is still true, preventing retries and leaving schema inconsistent.
